standard.summary: （实验性）Gram 矩阵风格 loss：通过计算特征图的 Gram 矩阵（通道间相关性），约束训练输出的纹理风格一致性。
standard.effect: Gram 矩阵捕捉特征的二阶统计量（等价于风格信息），此 loss 鼓励生成保持与目标相同的纹理/风格分布。
standard.whenToUse: 实验性功能。风格 LoRA 训练（希望输出保持特定艺术风格纹理）时可以尝试。
standard.avoidWhen: 默认关闭。Gram 矩阵计算需要完整的特征通道乘法（O(C²)），对大通道数（C>512）有一定计算开销。

standard_en.summary: (Experimental) Gram matrix style loss: computes the Gram matrix of the feature maps (inter-channel correlation) to constrain the texture and style consistency of the training output.
standard_en.effect: The Gram matrix captures the features' second-order statistics (equivalent to style information), and this loss encourages output to keep the same texture and style distribution as the target.
standard_en.whenToUse: An experimental feature. Worth trying for style LoRA training where the output should hold a particular artistic texture.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Off by default. The Gram matrix needs a full channel-wise multiplication (O(C^2)), which costs something at high channel counts (C>512).

advanced.principle: G = F × F^T，G_{ij} = <F_i, F_j>（特征图通道 i 和 j 的内积）。Gram 矩阵等价于特征空间的二阶矩，不保留空间位置信息（只捕捉风格而非内容）。normalize=True 对 Gram 矩阵按元素数归一化，防止深层特征因维度大而主导 loss。
advanced.tradeoffs: Gram loss 单纯约束风格，可能弱化对内容/结构的约束。通常应与 MSE loss 一起使用（Gram 权重设较小）。

advanced_en.principle: G = F × F^T, G_{ij} = <F_i, F_j> (inner product of feature channels i and j). The Gram matrix is the second moment of feature space and keeps no spatial-position information (captures style, not content). normalize=True normalizes the Gram matrix by element count, keeping deep features' large dimensionality from dominating the loss.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Gram loss constrains only style and can weaken content/structure constraints. Usually use alongside MSE loss (with a small Gram weight).
